newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: FORECAST - Metcash to post strong yr results.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Metcash to post strong yr results.

text.p: Africa's largest basic foods and household products distributor Metro Cash and Carry was seen posting firm year results boosted by a relatively strong food sector and offshore operations, analysts said on Wednesday.
"Food and groceries are a good sector to be in. They (Metcash) are doing well outside South Africa," said an analyst who asked not to be identified.
The group reports results for the year ended April 30 next Wednesday.
Metcash had a five-for-one share split last month.
Taking the share split into account, analysts polled by Reuters forecast earnings per share ranging between 16.9 cents and 17.1 cents with consensus at 17.1 cents from 13.64 cents.
The group's previous year earnings per share figure, before the share split was 68.2 cents.
Analysts polled by Reuters forecast this year's dividend at seven cents from 5.6 cents, after the share split. The actual previous dividend was 28 cents.
Metcash's operating margin had widened to 2.2 percent from 1.95 percent in the previous year, analysts said.
Analysts said that interest income would also help boost earnings.
